recs.x: Fun fact: Wiles’ proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem took him six years to complete in isolation, during which time he essentially told no one in the mathematical community that he was working on it. To prove it, he had to utilize results from number theory, algebraic geometry and category theory. He largely proved it in 1993, save for one error that he did not correct until 1995. One of my favorite videos on YouTube is a ~30 second clip of Wiles describing the moment he discovered the solution to the last remaining error in his proof: [link] .
